standard-dialogue.npc: Ah, hello and welcome. I'm Martin Holt, leader of Kourend's Royal Society. This is our little protest against the Kourend Council.

standard-dialogue.player: Pleased to meet you. I'm [player name]. So, what's wrong with the Council?

standard-dialogue.npc: Now there's a question! I have a better one. What's right with the Council?
I bet you didn't know that the Council was originally only temporary. After the last King died, they were only supposed to rule until his daughter came of age.
However, according to the Council, the King's daughter went mad. Such a wonderful convenience for them of course. With her out of the picture, the Council became permanent.

standard-dialogue.player: Interesting. What else don't you like about the Council?

standard-dialogue.npc: Democracy! That's meant to be the big thing for the Council. Funny thing is, although they're meant to be elected by the people, the same four people have won every single election. Little odd, no?

standard-dialogue.player: That is a bit suspicious, I suppose.

standard-dialogue.npc: Indeed it is. So, do you want to join our protest?

standard-dialogue.player: Not right now. But thanks for the information.

standard-dialogue.text: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the A Kingdom Divided quest.

standard-dialogue-after-a-kingdom-divide.player: Hello Martin. Now here's somewhere I wouldn't have expected to find you.

standard-dialogue-after-a-kingdom-divide.npc: Indeed. I never thought I'd be back here.
We won! The Council are out, and we have what Kourend really needed. We have a king!
Of course, King Artur ended up taking the throne from his father a little faster than anyone expected, so he needs plenty of guidance. That's where I come in!

standard-dialogue-after-a-kingdom-divide.player: So you're helping to advise the King?

standard-dialogue-after-a-kingdom-divide.npc: Exactly! When the people voted on Rose's Accord, they voted for the Hosidius family to become the new royal family. From a technical standpoint that means they voted for King Artur.

standard-dialogue-after-a-kingdom-divide.player: But in reality it was his father they expected to rule.

standard-dialogue-after-a-kingdom-divide.npc: Precisely. My job is to advise King Artur and ensure his actions have a positive impact on the people that he now rules.
Not too bad. While he lacks experience, the King has a good heart. He wants to do the right thing, and he has the support needed to do it.
Mind you, he could do with listening to his mother less. She's always whispering things in his ear. She forgets that he's the one in charge, not her.
Still, I'm sure he just needs time to adjust. I have no doubt that under King Artur, Kourend will prosper like never before.

standard-dialogue-after-a-kingdom-divide.player: I'm sure you're right. See you around Martin.

steps.npc: Only a king can right the wrongs of the Council! And only you can make that happen!
How long will you keep your eyes closed? Their corruption surrounds you!
This kingdom will never be safe while the Council rule!
You deserve the truth! They won't give it to you!
The Council have wronged you! It's time to make things right!
Together, we can bring an end to the treachery of the Council!
The Council care only for themselves! It's time for a ruler who cares for you!
Kourend is a kingdom! A kingdom needs a king, not a council!
Democracy? What democracy? It's all a façade!
People of Kourend, you have been lied to!
